# loGo/s runtime hook selection: the go command derives one boolean from the
# full root action graph at Builder.Do entry. A feature-free graph compiles
# package runtime from a generated objdir file defining
# logosRuntimeHooks = false; anything that can reach logos/rt, package
# plugin, or runtime's own test variant keeps the checked-in enabled
# default. The boolean is hashed only into runtime's action ID, so cache
# entries cannot cross-contaminate between selections and identical rebuilds
# reuse the archive.

[short] skip
[!GOOS:linux] skip
[!cgo] skip
[!buildmode:plugin] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $WORK/bin

# --- 1. Feature-free root: networking, defers, goroutines, no logos anywhere.

cd plain
go build -x -o $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE .
stderr '\-p runtime '
stderr '_logos_features\.go'
stderr 'logosRuntimeHooks = false'
! stderr 'src/runtime/logos_features\.go'
exec $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE
stdout '^7d ok$'

# Disabled selection must also type-check under vet with the generated file.
go vet runtime

# --- 2. Explicit logos/rt import keeps the checked-in enabled default.

cd ../usesrt
go build -x -o $WORK/bin/usesrt$GOEXE .
stderr '\-p runtime '
stderr 'src/runtime/logos_features\.go'
! stderr '_logos_features\.go'
! stderr 'logosRuntimeHooks = false'
exec $WORK/bin/usesrt$GOEXE
stdout '^hash ok$'

# Second identical ON build reuses the ON runtime archive: no recompile.
go build -x -o $WORK/bin/usesrt2$GOEXE .
! stderr '\-p runtime '
! stderr '_logos_features\.go'

# --- 3. OFF selection cache entry survives the intervening ON build.

cd ../plain
go build -x -o $WORK/bin/plain2$GOEXE .
! stderr '\-p runtime '
! stderr '_logos_features\.go'
exec $WORK/bin/plain2$GOEXE
stdout '^7d ok$'

# --- 4. Test-only logos dependency forces the enabled default for go test.

cd ../testonly
# Runtime ON is already cached from step 2, so read the selection from the
# compiled file list instead of a compile line: the checked-in default
# survives cache replay as a package-relative name, the generated variant
# would come back cache-hash-named. go list -deps prints dependencies
# before the named package, so anchor with the multiline flag.
go list -compiled -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.CompiledGoFiles}}' .
stdout '(?m)^runtime .*logos_features\.go'
go test .
stdout '^ok\s'

# --- 5. runtime's own internal tests run with hooks enabled.

go test runtime -run TestLogosGroupNetpollCancelBeforeRegister -count=1 -x
stderr 'src/runtime/logos_features\.go'
! stderr '_logos_features\.go'
stdout '^ok\s'

# --- 6. Coverage rewriting of the default file under a disabled selection.

cd ../plain
go build -x -cover -coverpkg=runtime -o $WORK/bin/plaincov$GOEXE .
stderr 'logosRuntimeHooks = false'
# Coverage rewriting legitimately names the checked-in file as the cover
# tool's input, and -x echoes coveroutfiles.txt listing every covered
# output; those are generation diagnostics, not compile inputs. Pin the
# runtime compile line itself: it must take the generated OFF file and
# never the rewritten default.
stderr '\-p runtime .*_logos_features\.go'
! stderr '\-p runtime .*logos_features\.cover\.go'
exec $WORK/bin/plaincov$GOEXE
stdout '^7d ok$'

# --- 7. Hook call sites: absent from a feature-free binary, present with logos/rt.

# Filtered to the logosRuntimeHooks-gated families: arena and region helpers
# carry their own GOEXPERIMENT gates and compile into feature-free binaries.
# Empty output proves the DCE'd OFF selection.
# The ON consumer calls group and trace APIs and checks their behavior; a
# hash-only import would select ON but leave these hooks linker-dead.
go tool objdump -s 'runtime\.logos(Group|Slot|Trace|Cancel)' $WORK/bin/plain$GOEXE
! stdout '.'
go tool objdump -s 'runtime\.logos(GroupAcquire|TraceRecord)' $WORK/bin/usesrt$GOEXE
stdout 'TEXT runtime\.logosGroupAcquire'
stdout 'TEXT runtime\.logosTraceRecord'

# --- 8. Plugin pairing: logos-using plugin loaded by a plain Go host.

cd ../plughost
go build -buildmode=plugin -o $WORK/bin/logosplug.so ./plug
go build -o $WORK/bin/host$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/host$GOEXE $WORK/bin/logosplug.so
stdout '^plugin ok$'

-- plain/go.mod --
module plain

go 1.27
-- plain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
)

func work() (s string) {
	defer func() { s += "d" }()
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	go func() { c <- 7 }()
	return fmt.Sprint(<-c)
}

func main() {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer ln.Close()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		c, err := ln.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			done <- err
			return
		}
		c.Close()
		done <- nil
	}()
	go func() {
		c, err := net.Dial("tcp", ln.Addr().String())
		if err != nil {
			done <- err
			return
		}
		c.Close()
		done <- nil
	}()
	if err := <-done; err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := <-done; err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(work(), "ok")
}
-- usesrt/go.mod --
module usesrt

go 1.27
-- usesrt/main.go --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
)

func main() {
	if rt.HashString("usesrt") == 0 {
		panic("zero hash")
	}
	g, ctx := rt.NewGroup(context.Background(), 1)
	traced := make(chan bool, 1)
	g.Go(func(context.Context) error {
		err := errors.New("trace probe")
		first := rt.Site{File: "usesrt/main.go", Line: 1}
		second := rt.Site{File: "usesrt/main.go", Line: 2}
		rt.TraceErr(err, &first)
		rt.TraceErr(err, &second)
		trace := rt.ErrorTrace()
		traced <- len(trace) == 2 && trace[0] == first && trace[1] == second
		return nil
	})
	if err := g.Wait(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if !<-traced {
		panic("error trace lost")
	}
	if ctx.Err() != context.Canceled {
		panic("group context not canceled at join")
	}
	fmt.Println("hash ok")
}
-- testonly/go.mod --
module testonly

go 1.27
-- testonly/x.go --
package x

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }
-- testonly/x_test.go --
package x

import (
	"testing"

	_ "logos/rt"
)

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("Add is broken")
	}
}
-- plughost/go.mod --
module plughost

go 1.27
-- plughost/plug/plug.go --
package main

import "logos/rt"

func Value() uint64 { return rt.HashString("plug") }
-- plughost/host.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"plugin"
)

func main() {
	p, err := plugin.Open(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	v, err := p.Lookup("Value")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f := v.(func() uint64)
	if f() == 0 {
		panic("zero value")
	}
	fmt.Println("plugin ok")
}
